evidence.evidence_text: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) are augmented with the ability to perceive audio, demonstrating impressive capabilities in processing combined audio and text signals.
This study examines how LALMs prioritize information when presented with inconsistent audio-text pairs.

We further investigate the influencing factors of text bias, explore mitigation strategies through supervised fine-tuning, and analyze model confidence patterns that reveal persistent overconfidence even with contradictory inputs.
